about: Scenes found on YouTube for each text, checked through YouTube's own embedded player (plays embedded, length) and its captions (the second each key line is spoken). themes are short names: power = abuse of power, men / women = the role of men / women. Found 2026-11-16.
how: Playlists listed through the embedded player (PL-KykV_4XmWNyOd5Nkvzfc8O4NPuSTUEu goes through the film in order; also PL2Of7J5L2SMIr0-mJhoyh_0KHOu5ASQkr, PL6H_6YWwXlwlmximnSlI1cyjvCiRzHXL1), then each video checked. Movieclips' own clips refuse to play embedded (error 150). Two clips of sexual assault (7jKCa54blg8, mBlJ9N7Ehgk) were left out. Later the same day: YouTube's own search page is served to the session without a consent wall, so scenes are now found by searching YouTube itself (scratchpad ytsearch.py reads the results page), which found what web search had missed for Small Things Like These and Sive.

sive_compared: Asked to find a better recording, 22 YouTube searches found 25 recordings of the play. Compared by the picture sizes YouTube offers, by frames from each (seek previews) and by captions. St Brigid's Drama Group (Vql0MTCXTiY): up to 1080p, several cameras with close-ups at nearly every key scene, natural colour, clear captions; the best filmed, though little watched (about 130 views). Dunhill Community Theatre (iT6YFBZ7OIc): up to 1080p and 59,000 views, but mostly one wide camera from the back of the hall, a strong yellow cast and the audience's heads in the picture. Athea 1993 (dTTZv_ANZG4): a 720p copy of a video tape, washed out. Lartigue 1997, Ruan 1998, Paddy Joyce's acts, Daithi O'Dalaigh's parts and Corofin's are 480p or less. The professional productions (Druid 2018, the Abbey) have only short promotional clips and interviews on YouTube.
